noor-kitchen.name: Noor's kitchen (Utrecht-Oost)
noor-kitchen.description: A small, cosy, lived-in kitchen in a Dutch city flat, seen from the doorway. Left wall: a run of sage-green lower cabinets with round brass knobs under a light-wood worktop, and white square wall tiles up to a single open wooden shelf. On the worktop from left to right: a two-ring electric hob with a small saucepan on it, a stainless-steel sink with a curved tap and a dish rack holding two plates and a mug, a wooden chopping board with a bread knife and half a loaf, an electric kettle, and a small black coffee machine. On the open shelf: a row of mismatched mugs, glass jars of pasta, rice and muesli, and a small stack of plates. Below the shelf a magnetic knife strip and a rail with hanging utensils: a ladle, a spatula, a whisk and a tea towel. Next to the cabinets a narrow white fridge with a few magnets and a shopping list on it. Right wall: a large window with a white frame, three potted herbs on the sill, and a view of red-brick terraced houses across the street. In front of the window a small square light-wood table with exactly two wooden chairs facing each other, and a small fruit bowl with apples in the middle. Pale cream walls, a small round wall clock above the doorway, a light terracotta floor, warm morning light.
